hum verb

also buzz, murmur, hum (noun)

classical

Traupman 330

murmurō, murmurāre, murmurāvī, murmurātum

verb, first conjugation

hum, murmur

Other words

  • murmur, murmuris n. — a hum, a murmur

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Traupman 330

    Neuter (Lewis & Short); Traupman prints it as masculine.

  • bombus, bombī m. — a hum, a buzz (of bees)

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Traupman 330

    A deep humming or booming sound; of bees, of a horn, of clapping (Lewis & Short).

  • bombilō, bombilāre — hum, buzz (of bees)

    verb, first conjugation · also used · late Latin · Traupman 330

See also purr, tune.
